predicate.label: executive of
predicate.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
ambiguous: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

rationale: Executive office is the strongest explicit title family; chief/head/chair alone is not silently broadened into executive.
